script: Parece ficção científica, mas é 100% real: Northflank security breach leads to abuse of customers' AI API keys. Uma investigação detalhada divulgada pela BleepingComputer trouxe à tona os seguintes fatos: Cloud application hosting platform Northflank is warning customers to rotate all credentials and secrets stored on its platform after a security breach led to unauthorized use of customers' AI API keys.
